label: Paper cutout (layered cardstock animation)
summary: Layered paper and cardstock puppets with visible cut edges and split-pin joints, moved on twos over textured paper sets.
look: Paper cutout animation. Characters and sets are cut from layered coloured cardstock and textured paper with visible cut edges, slight fibres, split-pin joints and small real drop shadows between layers. Flat layered depth like a diorama, soft even top light, warm crafted colour palette. Never 3D-rendered, never photoreal.
character_medium: one original paper cutout puppet character assembled from layered coloured cardstock with visible cut edges, split-pin joints at the shoulders, elbows and knees, simple graphic face, subtle drop shadows between layers
sheet_backdrop: Plain textured paper backdrop, flat even light, puppet laid out flat.
plate_medium: a layered paper-cutout diorama set made of textured cardstock layers, empty of characters
vehicle_medium: a layered paper-cutout vehicle with split-pin wheels
motion: Cutout animation on twos: 12 poses per second, limbs rotate around split pins, flat layers slide past each other, no motion blur, no 3D rotation of flat parts.
constraints: No 3D rendering, no photoreal people, no smooth gradients, no motion blur, no readable text, no logos.
lighting_menu: warm lamp light with paper shadows
night scene in blue paper with cut-out stars
critic: everything still reads as paper (cut edges, layers, split pins)
